audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rates this 7.5/10 difficulty and tone #ff8b3d (tricky) while its own phases give Akali levels 3 onward and the data says 52.92% over 1561 games. It also opens 'He stacks armor + MR'.
audit.why: Malphite has no MR in his kit at all - Thunderclap grants bonus armour and Ground Slam scales off armour. The mirror entry malphite__akali.json states the same and gives Akali the lane from level 3. I corrected the false MR claim; I did not move diffRating because that number ripples into breakdown.difficulty and report[14] and the mirror's own rating is not something I can see from here - it is in questionsForUser.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0].t no longer claim MR; the chart and diffRating are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said Akali spikes at 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' and gave Malphite's level 6 no number.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud cannot be learned before level 3, so the Akali spike is level 3, not 2. Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s - the longest cooldown in the lane and the actual thing you play around. The mirror entry makes the same level-3 correction from Malphite's side.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, phases[0].why and phases[4].why rebuilt on level 3 and the 130s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield never appeared; the content layer twice attributed the shield to 'his W'; and breakdown.cooldowns described Unstoppable Force only as 'Un-dodgeable burst'.
audit.why: The shield is Granite Shield (P), absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges if he has not been hit for a few seconds - so it is a thing you chip off before committing, and it is the reason a clean burst sometimes fails. Thunderclap (W) is the armour/aftershock ability, not a shield. Ground Slam (E) deals magic damage scaled off his Armor, which is why his armour stacking is offence as well as defence, and Seismic Shard (Q) steals your move speed for 3s rather than only slowing.
audit.corrected: Full-layer report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry Granite Shield, the armour-scaling on Ground Slam and Seismic Shard's move-speed steal; content whys[5] and spikes[3].text now say Granite Shield instead of 'his W shield'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer named a single Malphite ability in the content layer - the defect scan flagged exactly that.
audit.why: Seismic Shard, Thunderclap, Ground Slam, Granite Shield and Unstoppable Force are the names a player sees on the enemy bar; 'his Q slow' and 'W-empowered auto' cost the same characters and say less.
audit.corrected: content whys[0]/[1]/[2]/[5], spikes[0].text, spikes[3].text, wants.you[2], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] now use the real names.

notes: Malphite's kit file flags Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E) as 'grounding'; Riot's descriptions say move-speed steal and attack-speed slow only, so I treated that as a tooltip-parse misfire and never claimed Malphite can deny Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution — the mirror entry reached the same conclusion. The _missing rule 'Malphite bypasses stacking resistances (Granite Shield)' is also a misfire: Granite Shield is a damage-absorbing shield, not resistance-bypassing damage.
